purpose: Determine whether observed debt-service/credit-risk and prudential states can be mapped directly into a scalar credit_supply_capacity node without conflating asset quality, bank capital/funding constraints, lending standards and loan demand.

ecb_bls_supply_demand_boundary.finding: The BLS explicitly separates information on loan supply from loan demand. Credit standards are banks' internal guidelines or loan-approval criteria, while loan demand is separately reported.

ecb_credit_quality_effect.finding: Banks report that NPL ratios and other credit-quality indicators can have a tightening impact on credit standards through risk perceptions, risk tolerance, supervisory/regulatory requirements and balance-sheet clean-up costs.
ecb_credit_quality_effect.interpretation: Credit quality can influence lending standards, but the NPL ratio is not itself a scalar lending-capacity state and the effect is not a one-to-one identity.

retained_prudential_population_review.implication: ECB CBD2 prudential controls cannot silently replace BNR Romanian-legal-entity prudential indicators because population, control basis, consolidation and reporting coverage differ.

retained_aggregate_credit_review.npl_role: Prudential/credit-risk state control, not an exogenous bank-supply shock.
retained_aggregate_credit_review.total_capital_ratio_role: Banking-system prudential state control, not an exogenous supply shock and not a substitute for a capital-buffer shock.
retained_aggregate_credit_review.bls_credit_standards_role: Direct survey proxy for reported changes in bank lending standards/supply conditions, not automatically a causal instrument.
retained_aggregate_credit_review.bls_loan_demand_role: Direct survey proxy for reported loan demand, kept separate from supply standards.

structural_interpretation.risk_state_role: Borrower/asset-quality and debt-service conditions can affect banks' risk perceptions, provisioning/clean-up pressures and willingness to lend.
structural_interpretation.prudential_state_role: Capital, solvency, liquidity and funding conditions constrain or buffer lending decisions but are endogenous banking-system states and boundary-specific.
structural_interpretation.lending_standards_role: Observed survey measure of changes in banks' approval criteria/supply conditions, not an accounting capacity stock.
structural_interpretation.credit_supply_capacity_role: Qualitative umbrella for the ability/willingness of banks to extend credit after risk, prudential, funding, regulatory and demand interactions. No single exact observed scalar is frozen.

candidate_observable_family: realised BLS credit standards by borrower sector
